description: Per question and localiser, the 1-based rank of the first chunk of the gold document that overlaps the union of the annotators' evidence ('union') and each distinct evidence paragraph ('spans', aligned with the question's 'spans'; null where a cross-encoder was not rerun because every reference is the union's gold). Character ranges index the paper body built by src/data/loaders/qasper.py; no dataset text is stored.
